news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics CEO frames LEVEL trial miss as a patient-selection lesson at Cantor Healthcare Conference
news.summary: Speaking at the Cantor Global Healthcare Conference on September 9, President and CEO Chris Giordano told investors the LEVEL trial missed its walk-distance goal but showed strong biological effects, saying the company is 'disappointed with not hitting stat sig, but we are not disillusioned... we are not disheartened.' Shares rallied roughly 10% intraday as management reiterated plans to pursue an enriched, subgroup-based registrational path with the FDA and EMA.

news.headline: Wall Street consensus on Tenax Therapeutics slips to Hold as analysts digest LEVEL data
news.summary: Aggregated brokerage coverage of Tenax now averages a Hold rating (5 hold, 3 buy, 1 strong buy and 1 sell among ten analysts), with the average 12-month target down sharply after Evercore ISI cut the stock to In Line with a $5 target. The consensus shift reflects how divided sell-side analysts remain on the value of the LEVEL subgroup and biomarker data following the primary-endpoint miss.

news.headline: ADAR1 Capital Management and Daniel Schneeberger extend Tenax Therapeutics buying spree past 5.6 million shares
news.summary: Funds managed by ADAR1 Capital Management, together with Daniel Schneeberger, kept buying into early September - including 187,704 shares on September 2 and additional blocks on September 3-4, all at roughly $1.70-$1.80 - pushing their combined stake to more than 5.6 million shares, over 13% of the company. It remains the clearest insider-conviction signal in the stock since the LEVEL primary-endpoint miss.

news.headline: Guggenheim downgrades Tenax Therapeutics to Neutral from Buy after reviewing full ESC LEVEL data
news.summary: Guggenheim moved off its Buy rating to Neutral with no price target, citing substantial clinical and regulatory uncertainty after digesting the complete LEVEL dataset presented at ESC. It had already slashed its price target to $4 from $40 right after the August 10 primary-endpoint miss while still rating the stock Buy, so this is a further step down.

news.headline: Full Phase 3 LEVEL data presented as a late-breaker at ESC Congress 2026 in Munich
news.summary: Professor Sanjiv Shah presented the complete LEVEL dataset: in the prespecified subgroup with baseline 6-minute walk distance below the trial median of 333m, levosimendan improved 6MWD by 26.3m versus placebo (p=0.0112), cut NT-proBNP by roughly 47-49% and improved right ventricular systolic pressure, with about 20 echocardiographic parameters improved across every domain measured. This subgroup and biomarker depth underpins Tenax's plan to pursue a narrower, enriched registrational path with the FDA and EMA.

news.headline: Tenax Therapeutics Announces Topline Results from Phase 3 LEVEL Clinical Trial of TNX-103 in Patients with PH-HFpEF
news.summary: The pivotal LEVEL trial missed its primary endpoint (6-minute walk distance, +3.5m vs placebo, p=0.63) and its key secondary endpoint (KCCQ), though prespecified subgroups of sicker patients showed a meaningful walk-distance benefit and strong biomarker/hemodynamic effects. Shares collapsed roughly 87-90% on the news, and Tenax said it would seek an FDA Type C meeting (and EMA scientific consultation) to discuss a revised registrational path using an enrichment strategy.

catalysts.label: FDA Type C meeting on levosimendan path forward
catalysts.detail: Tenax has requested a Type C meeting with the FDA (with parallel EMA scientific consultation) to discuss an enrichment strategy for a revised registrational program, using the subgroup and biomarker data presented at ESC and the FDA's earlier agreement that a single well-controlled Phase 3 with p=0.01 could support an NDA. No meeting date has been publicly confirmed yet; the outcome will determine whether LEVEL-2 is modified or a new study is required.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings / cash runway and strategy update
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly report is expected around November 18, 2026 and should update the cash position (guided to a runway through Q2 2028 as of June 30, 2026) and lay out concrete next steps for the levosimendan program following the LEVEL trial failure, including any outcome from the FDA Type C meeting request.

catalysts.label: LEVEL-2 Phase 3 enrollment completion
catalysts.detail: The global, roughly 540-patient LEVEL-2 registrational trial (2:1 randomization) remains ongoing, with enrollment completion guided to end of 2027 as of the Q2 2026 update. Design and eligibility criteria may still be revised pending FDA feedback from the planned Type C meeting.

pulse: TENX has stabilized in the roughly $1.80-$2.20 range since the LEVEL primary-endpoint miss, bouncing modestly (up nearly 10% intraday) after CEO Chris Giordano's September 9 Cantor Global Healthcare Conference appearance recast the trial as a patient-selection problem rather than a dead program. Sell-side sentiment has cooled further even so, with the analyst consensus sliding to Hold (Evercore now In Line at $5, Guggenheim Neutral) after the fuller ESC data dump, while the standout bullish counter-signal is continued insider buying: ADAR1 Capital Management/Daniel Schneeberger funds have pushed their stake past 5.6 million shares (over 13%) through early September at $1.70-$1.80. With about $118M of cash guided into Q2 2028, the next catalysts are the still-unscheduled FDA Type C meeting on an enriched LEVEL-2 path and the Q3 earnings update expected mid-November.
